summary: A generative Irish ambient firmware forked from NACHTFAHRT: harps over a drone with a flute, fiddle, chanter or voice leading in the old modes. It plays by itself from power-on and responds when you play.
features: Eight pieces in modal and gapped scales; jig-style 12 and 9-step harps
White keys play the Lead in the piece's scale, and it answers
PERFORM page: 27 hold-to-play effects on the whole mix
MIDI clock, CCs, program changes; four parts sent out over USB MIDI
Sleep timer; browser editor and painted visualiser
Its first save replaces NACHTFAHRT, DUB-1 or AMB-1 data
